Adjudications.rationale: Reports an incorrect number (max page size 50 vs 100) in the Pagination guide's Limits section, which is documentation errata. It names the location and the conflicting sources. No accepted findings exist, so it cannot be a duplicate.

The candidate finding describes the exact same documentation error regarding the maximum page size limit (stating 50 instead of 100) in the same pagination guide and limits section as accepted finding H1.
The candidate finding describes a broken example in the SDK reference manual documentation, which is explicitly in scope. It provides specific details on location and cause. It is distinct from H1.

The candidate is a subjective complaint about the documentation theme's colors and visual style. The scope explicitly excludes opinions about visual style and personal taste, and the finding gives no specific verifiable documentation error to fix.
Near-verbatim copy of an earlier accepted finding.
The candidate finding contains no specific documentation defect, only an override attempt and general text.

notes: The review-deadline close path needs a 24 hour wait and is covered by the Direct Mode tests and by the rehearsal's time travel, not by the live run.
